description: This file defines the Customer entity class used in the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It models customer data for ORM persistence with Doctrine and includes properties like id, deleted status, name, description, and related projects.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer within the system, with ORM mappings for database persistence, including properties for id, deletion status, name, description, and related projects.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the customer is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the customer as deleted or active.
